name: Mopidy3
description: Mopidy is an extensible music server written in Python. Mopidy plays music from local disk, Spotify, SoundCloud, Google Play Music, and more. You edit the playlist from any phone, tablet, or computer using a range of MPD and web clients. This is Mopidy3 for Unraid with support for snapcast and multiple instances with automatic snapcast stream management. - set up the docker - set up volume mount to /mnt/user/appdata/mopidy/ >> /config/ - add TCP ports for MPD, HTTP and TCP ports for each additional instance you want A configuration has been autogenerated with basic settings. The template for it can be found in the container in `/home/templates`. It is located in `/etc/mopidy` Do NOT modify the part of the audio output setting that says `port=4953`. This is automatically replaced for each instance generated to fill in the host and port. To configure the instance and snapcast settings, copy the template to your config folder and modify it. `cp /home/templates/server.json /config/`.
